description: Stores what the user found at a camping spot (outcome: camped, signal_worked, signal_failed, road_as_described, road_worse, closed, no_camping_sign), read by the next scouting-list build. Needs the user's Camp Map Pass key; shares the daily cap of 10 stored reports.
